audit.why: 55.93% over 792 games — the highest win rate in this slice — with a chart that hands Yone levels 3-5 and both item stages. As with Volibear and Yasuo, the prose reconciles it: Camille's win comes from the level-2-3 and level-6 windows and from closing the game before two crit items, not from the full-build duel. Internally consistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 covers only Camille's ultimate. Fate Sealed is never mentioned anywhere in the matchup, and the late-game section lists 'his Q dash, E spirit-rewind and Q3 knockup' as his threats while omitting his ultimate entirely.
audit.why: Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1 down to 80s — a long-range dash that marks everything in a line and pulls it in. In lane it is a second gap-closer he does not otherwise have at 6, and in the skirmishes the late section describes it is the reason he can reach Camille after she has committed. A level-6 entry that discusses only her arena is telling the reader half the stage.
audit.corrected: Fate Sealed named at 6 with its 120s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: early calls his E 'Spirit Unbound'. Yone's E is Soul Unbound. His Q is only 'his Q' and 'Q3', his passive never appears, and Camille's R is written without its article.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon: Way of the Hunter (P), Mortal Steel (Q), Spirit Cleave (W), Soul Unbound (E), Fate Sealed (R). 'Spirit Unbound' is a blend of his W and E names and is not an ability. The cooldown that decides this lane is also absent: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1, falling to 10s at rank 5, against Hookshot's 16s. At rank 1 his escape is on a LONGER cooldown than her engage — which is exactly why the 'punish him every time his E is down' advice works early and stops working later, and neither half of that is stated. Mortal Steel is 4s and Spirit Cleave is 14s.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound named correctly with its 22s-to-10s curve; Mortal Steel, Spirit Cleave, Way of the Hunter and Fate Sealed named; R given its article.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Force all-ins while his E is on cooldown', 'punish him every time his E spirit-rewind is down' and 'save R for when his E is on cooldown' all name the same cooldown three times without ever giving it.
audit.why: 22s at rank 1 versus 16s Hookshot is a genuinely winning trade of cooldowns and is the strongest early argument in the matchup; by rank 5 it is 10s versus 12s and the argument reverses. Stating both ends explains why the lane decays rather than just asserting that it does.
audit.corrected: 22s written into whys[3] and mid, with the decay noted in late.

audit.why: The matchup makes the right distinction and makes it twice: Spirit Cleave gives Yone a shield, not sustain, so it cannot answer Tactical Sweep's self-heal in a long trade. That is an accurate reading of Riot's flags and it is the reason the level 2-5 window exists.

edits.before: With Q up and a point in E, you E-stun in, auto, then hold the Q recast for the bonus true-damage second hit — that burst wins every short trade before his Q stacks charge to the knockup.
edits.after: With Q up and a point in E you Hookshot in, auto, then hold the Q recast for the true-damage second hit — that burst wins short trades before Mortal Steel charges to its knockup dash.

edits.before: Hextech Ultimatum walls him into the arena so he can't Q-dash or kite out — the isolated 1v1 is your cleanest all-in window, and his W shield alone won't survive it.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum walls him in so Mortal Steel and a 22s Soul Unbound can't carry him out — and a Spirit Cleave shield alone won't survive it. Watch his 120s Fate Sealed.

edits.before: At 2+ crit items his Q dash, E spirit-rewind and Q3 knockup make him impossible to pin for a full R, and his crit DPS overtakes you — close the lane before this.
edits.after: At 2+ crit items Mortal Steel's dash, a 10s Soul Unbound and Fate Sealed make him impossible to pin for a full R, and his crit DPS overtakes you — close before this.

edits.before: Your Q cooldown drops and you out-duel a pre-crit Yone — punish him every time his E spirit-rewind is down.
edits.after: Your Q cooldown drops and you out-duel a pre-crit Yone — punish inside Soul Unbound's 22s, longer than your E.

edits.before: Your Q true damage plus W's max-HP damage and self-heal out-trade him; his W only shields, so it can't match your sustain.
edits.after: Your Q true damage plus W's max-HP damage and self-heal out-trade him; Spirit Cleave only shields, so it can't match your sustain.

edits.before: Land R to wall him into the arena so he can't Q-dash or E-rewind out of the all-in
edits.after: Land R to wall him in so Mortal Steel and Soul Unbound can't carry him out of the all-in

edits.before: Poke with W Spirit Cleave at range and E-rewind back to his body to dodge your committed trades
edits.after: Poke with Spirit Cleave every 14s and rewind Soul Unbound to his body to dodge your committed trades

edits.before: Land a Q3 knockup or use it to peel your dive and survive into a teamfight hyper-carry
edits.after: Land the charged Mortal Steel knockup or hold Fate Sealed to peel your dive and survive

edits.before: Yone is even-ish at Level 1 — neither of you has a real all-in tool yet, so deny his CS and set up your Level 2 spike. Once you hit 2-3 you E-stun in, auto, then hold Q for the bonus true-damage second hit; that combo out-trades him before his Q stacks charge to the knockup-dash. Bait his E — if he spends Spirit Unbound just to rewind out of a trade, you've won the cooldown war. Watch his Q3 (the charged third cast dashes and knocks up), so don't facecheck a Yone who's been stacking it.
edits.after: Yone is even-ish at Level 1 — neither of you has a real all-in tool yet, so deny his CS and set up your Level 2 spike. Once you hit 2-3 you Hookshot in, auto, then hold Q for the true-damage second hit; that combo out-trades him before Mortal Steel charges to its knockup dash. Bait his E — Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 against your 16s, so a rewind spent to escape a trade genuinely loses him the cooldown war. Don't facecheck a Yone who has been stacking Mortal Steel.

edits.before: This is your window. Your Q true damage and W's max-HP damage plus self-heal let you out-trade him — his W only gives him a shield, not sustain, so it can't match your healing — and your first-item Sheen spike lands before his crit core does. At 6, R is the key: it walls him into the arena so he can't Q-dash away or E back to his marked body, turning a trade into a kill instead of watching him slip out. Force all-ins while his E is on cooldown.
edits.after: This is your window. Your Q true damage and W's max-HP damage plus self-heal out-trade him — Spirit Cleave only shields, so it can't match your healing — and your first-item Sheen spike lands before his crit core. At 6 The Hextech Ultimatum walls him in so neither Mortal Steel nor Soul Unbound carries him back to his marked body, turning a trade into a kill. Force all-ins inside Soul Unbound's 22s, and respect a 120s Fate Sealed.

edits.before: Once Yone finishes two crit items he flips this lane — his Q dash, E spirit-rewind and Q3 knockup make him a slippery carry you can't reliably pin for a full R, and his crit/on-hit DPS overtakes your bruiser damage. Your job is to have already won. Snowball the early game, take plates and tempo, and end before his items come online; in teamfights save R for when his E is on cooldown so he can't rewind to his body and escape the isolation.
edits.after: Once Yone finishes two crit items he flips this lane — Mortal Steel's dash, the charged knockup and a Soul Unbound now down to 10s make him a carry you can't reliably pin for a full R, and his crit DPS overtakes your bruiser damage. That decay is the point: his E started at 22s and ends shorter than your Hookshot. Snowball early, take plates, and end before his items land; in fights, save R for a spent Soul Unbound.

notes: 'Spirit Unbound' was a fabricated ability name — a blend of Spirit Cleave and Soul Unbound. The larger gap was Fate Sealed being absent from the entire matchup, including from a late-game paragraph that lists his escape tools by name; a 120s ranged pull is both his level-6 spike and the reason he can re-reach Camille after she commits. Also added the cooldown curve that makes the existing advice make sense: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 against Hookshot's 16s, but 10s at rank 5 against 12s, so the 'punish him when his E is down' plan is genuinely strong early and genuinely dead late — which is the mechanical reason behind the 'close the game early' instruction the matchup already gives.
